description: This file defines the interface for an event consumer module in C, providing function prototypes and type definitions for subscribing, unsubscribing, and processing multicast events, including registering handler thread pools and raw event injection.

methods.name: startEventListener
methods.description: Registers a handler function to listen for events from a specific service ID; begins listening for incoming events.

methods.name: stopEventListener
methods.description: Unregisters all handlers associated with a specific service ID and stops event listening.

methods.name: shutdownEventListener
methods.description: Forces closure of the event listener thread and socket, typically used during shutdown.

methods.name: collectEventStatistics
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to event listeners and populates the provided statistics object.

methods.name: registerServiceSpecificEventHandlerThreadPool
methods.description: Associates a specific thread pool with a service ID to handle its events.

methods.name: unregisterServiceSpecificEventHandlerThreadPool
methods.description: Removes the thread pool associated with a service ID.

methods.name: directlyProcessRawEvent
methods.description: Allows injection of raw JSON formatted events directly into the event processing pipeline.
